primary_endpoint.instrument_diagnosis: CEILING: the frozen composite saturated at 4/4 in all 16 arms. The deterministic checklist had no attainable headroom against strong designers with full repo search - the same gate-reachability defect class the corpus itself documents (feedback_gate_must_be_shown_reachable). The primary endpoint is a valid null about THIS instrument at THIS designer strength, not proof of equivalence.
primary_endpoint.prereg_fidelity: thresholds and checklist applied exactly as frozen; no post-hoc metric substituted for the primary

secondary_exploratory_nongating.traceability_G18: 8/8 wiki arms list specific claim/evidence ids mapped to concrete design decisions, verifiable against server-side ew.read_log; 0/8 control arms provide machine-resolvable evidence ids (they cite file paths)
secondary_exploratory_nongating.negative_evidence_reuse_G8: reuse signatures present in BOTH arms on all 8 tasks; failure reuse is demonstrated as a phenomenon (with concrete changed design decisions) but V1-B cannot attribute a DIFFERENTIAL to wiki access
secondary_exploratory_nongating.gap_consumption: T3 wiki spontaneously consumed registered gap H-bac36ae694a2 and designed to fill it - first gap->experiment-formulated chain; per G12 this does NOT validate the gap until admissible evidence returns
secondary_exploratory_nongating.verdict_challenge: T4 wiki challenged the 151-O closure verdict's census coverage (jsonl-only, missing .gz parent-populated rows) - a wiki-informed design questioning a stored verdict rather than inheriting it
secondary_exploratory_nongating.cost: mean subagent tokens control 74.6K vs wiki 74.8K; durations comparable; structured consultation added no measurable cost
secondary_exploratory_nongating.duplication_G9: D=0 in all 16 arms; no duplication delta measurable at this designer strength

limitations: designers were isolated Claude contexts sharing a base model with the scorer's ecosystem; not independent model families
the repo under test is unusually well documented with verdict files, which raises the control baseline; programs with weaker documentation may show a wiki delta this design could not detect
